name: cursor
description: Dispatch tasks to Cursor cloud agents, check status, read conversations, and generate PowerPoint presentations. Send a task via followup message, poll agent status, review conversation history to extract results, dispatch PPT generation that uploads to Supabase Storage, bootstrap a fresh agent session's env, and write minimal adventurer system prompts. All executable logic lives in the paired cursor weapon; this skill holds the prompt/procedure registry.
author: GuildOS
